question: o10
q: How many people rode the Sydney Metro last Friday?

transcript.answer:
I can't tell you how many people rode the Sydney Metro last Friday (16 October 2026). My tools don't have daily Metro line ridership. The closest data I can reach is monthly Opal tap-ons for Sydney's commercial centres, and it's unclear whether those include Metro taps.

For the Sydney CBD, the average Tuesday-to-Thursday 3pm-7pm tap-ons per day were:
- 226,758 in January 2026
- 255,927 in September 2026 (the latest month available)

The most direct source for last Friday's figure is the TfNSW Open Data portal, which publishes daily Opal tap data. Transport for NSW may also report Metro patronage in its own releases.
